contactCta.title: Can't find your answer?
contactCta.description: Our support team is here to help you
contactCta.emailBody: Hi, I have a question about the WorkTi app:

1.question: How do I start using the app?
1.answer: To get started, go to Settings > My Jobs and add your first job. Define schedules, location and rates. Then you can start logging time from the main screen.

2.question: How do I record my work time?
2.answer: From the main screen, select your job and press the start button. The app will automatically start tracking your time. Press finish when you're done.

3.question: Can I edit my time records?
3.answer: Yes, go to the calendar and select any day to view your records. You can edit start time, end time and add notes.

4.question: How does geolocation work?
4.answer: The app uses your location to verify that you are at your workplace. You can set a tolerance radius in each job's settings.

5.question: How do I set up billing?
5.answer: In each job, go to the "Billing" tab and define your hourly rate. The app will automatically calculate your earnings based on time worked.

6.question: Is my data secure?
6.answer: All your data is stored locally on your device. We don't send personal information to external servers.

7.question: Can I export my data?
7.answer: Yes, you can export your data from the Reports screen. You can choose between PDF or Excel format for your time records.

8.question: Why isn't location working?
8.answer: Check that you have given location permissions to the app. Go to Device Settings > Privacy > Location and enable permissions.

9.question: Can I create notifications to remind me when I should go to work?
9.answer: Yes, on the calendar screen, when adding a schedule you'll see a button to create a notification that will remind you when to go to work.

10.question: Can I export work days to the phone's native calendar?
10.answer: Yes, from the calendar screen you can sync with your native calendar using the sync button.

11.question: Does it work with Apple Watch?
11.answer: Yes. You can start, pause and finish your workday from your wrist, check your week and your statistics, and add hours to a day — without taking out your phone. What you do on one appears on the other.

12.question: Does the app work without internet connection?
12.answer: Yes, it works perfectly without an internet connection. Everything is stored on your device, so you can clock in, check your calendar and look at your hours with no signal.

13.question: Do I need a subscription for all features?
13.answer: To enjoy 100% of all features you need a premium subscription. The free version includes one job and basic features.

14.question: How does GPS Auto-Timer work?
14.answer: Auto-Timer automatically detects when you arrive or leave work using GPS. You can configure detection radius and delays for start/stop.

15.question: Can I generate professional invoices?
15.answer: Yes, the premium version includes a complete billing system with company data, tax calculation and professional PDF export.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy

priority.title: Your Privacy is Our Priority
priority.description: At Working Time Control, we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our work time tracking application.

summary.title: Summary: We Store Absolutely Nothing
summary.subtitle: Your privacy in 4 clear points:

points.noPersonalData: We don't ask for personal data (name, email, phone, addresses)
points.noAnalytics: We don't do behavioral analytics or personalized advertising

summary.emphasis: Everything stays on your device. We store absolutely nothing.

local.title: 100% Local Storage
local.description: All your work data, including job information, time records, schedules, and settings are stored exclusively on your device. We have no access to this information.

cloud.title: No Cloud Servers
cloud.description: We don't have databases or cloud servers that store your personal information. Your data never leaves your device unless you explicitly choose to export or share it.

accounts.title: No User Accounts
accounts.description: The app works without creating user accounts, which means we don't collect or store personal identification information like names, email addresses, or phone numbers.

backup.title: Data Backup
backup.description: Since all data is stored locally on your device, you are responsible for creating regular backups. The app provides export functionality to help you save your data securely.

anonymous.title: Anonymous Processing
anonymous.description: Messages sent to the AI chatbot are processed anonymously through Google's Gemini API. No personal information is included in these requests.

chat.title: No Chat Storage
chat.description: We don't store chat history or conversations on our servers. All chat data remains on your device.

images.title: Image Analysis
images.description: Images analyzed by AI are processed temporarily and are not stored on external servers.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.description: Purchases are managed by Apple App Store / Google Play. To validate your subscription we use RevenueCat, sending only:

revenuecatData.identifier: A random, app-scoped identifier (doesn't personally identify you)
revenuecatData.receipt: The purchase receipt provided by Apple/Google

subscriptions.purpose: This ID is used exclusively to manage the subscription (activate/restore) and is not linked to your real identity.

noCollection.title: We don't collect:
noCollection.noPersonalInfo: We don't ask for name, email, phone or addresses
noCollection.noAnalytics: We don't do behavioral analytics or personalized advertising

location.title: Location Data
location.description: Location data is used solely for the automatic timer functionality and is stored locally on your device. Location information is never transmitted to our servers.
location.background: Background location usage is strictly limited to auto-timer functionality. It is never used for marketing or advertising tracking purposes.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.description: The app may send data to external services (e.g. Google Gemini for chatbot, RevenueCat for subscriptions). This data is processed anonymously and cannot be used to personally identify you. We, as developers, do not collect or store this information.
thirdParty.stores: App stores for distribution and payments
thirdParty.note: These services follow their own privacy policies:

security.title: Data Security
security.description: Since all data is stored locally on your device, data security depends on your device's security measures. We recommend using device encryption and secure lock screens.

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.description: Our app is not designed for children under 13 years old. We don't knowingly collect personal information from minors.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.description: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted in the app and will take effect immediately after publication.
changes.commitment: We commit that no changes to this policy will compromise your privacy or anonymity. We will always preserve the fundamental principle: we store nothing about you.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.description: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us at

privacy.footer: This policy is effective from September 2025 and applies to all versions of Working Time Control.
